{
  "scenario_id": "sc-da1123",
  "overall_assessment": "anomalies",
  "findings": [
    {
      "benefit": "Death",
      "years": [2018, 2024],
      "pattern": "drift",
      "direction": "increase",
      "magnitude": "~+0.07/yr, from 0.74 to 1.14",
      "confidence": 0.8,
      "evidence": [
        "ae_death_by_year.csv: monotonic rise from 2018 trough (0.744) through 2024 (1.142)"
      ],
      "recommended_action": "Review mortality improvement scales and exposure quality; consider pricing overlay or reserve strengthening if trend persists beyond sampling noise."
    },
    {
      "benefit": "CI",
      "years": [2022, 2024],
      "pattern": "drift",
      "direction": "increase",
      "magnitude": "~+0.06/yr, from 1.00 to 1.145",
      "confidence": 0.85,
      "evidence": [
        "ae_ci_by_year.csv: flat A/E ~0.90-1.00 until 2022, then sustained step-up to 1.145"
      ],
      "recommended_action": "Analyse claim incidence by diagnosis and underwriting criteria; check for coding changes, severity inflation, or relaxed underwriting driving higher A/E."
    },
    {
      "benefit": "TPD",
      "years": [2022, 2024],
      "pattern": "drift",
      "direction": "increase",
      "magnitude": "~+0.06/yr, from 1.00 to 1.115",
      "confidence": 0.75,
      "evidence": [
        "ae_tpd_by_year.csv: consistent upward move in final two years (1.000 -> 1.092 -> 1.115)"
      ],
      "recommended_action": "Assess TPD duration trends and medical cost inflation; validate termination assumptions and review case management practices."
    },
    {
      "benefit": "IP",
      "years": [2015, 2024],
      "pattern": "drift",
      "direction": "increase",
      "magnitude": "~+0.015/yr, from 0.93 to 1.08",
      "confidence": 0.7,
      "evidence": [
        "ae_ip_by_year.csv: gradual, consistent upward slope over full period despite minor year-on-year noise"
      ],
      "recommended_action": "Evaluate return-to-work drivers and economic environment impact; IP termination A/E remains near 1.0 across diagnoses, so focus on frequency/severity and case management."
    }
  ]
}
